meaning.hi: सब पापों का नाश करने वाला

meaning.en: below the root bulb at the base of the left thigh
meaning.hi: बाईं जाँघ के मूल में कन्द के नीचे

meaning.en: should place on top of it
with neck, head and trunk in one line
meaning.hi: गर्दन, सिर और धड़ को सम रखकर

meaning.en: up to the point between the eyebrows
the stirring of the Saraswati channel
by knowers of the ancient lore
by the very stirring of which
while the breath flows in the left channel
meaning.hi: जब प्राण इडा में बह रहा हो

meaning.en: for the span of two muhurtas
in which the coiled one lies
through the sun channel, the right nostril
merely by the stirring of which
lodged in the middle of the trunk
by the stirring of the power
one should practise the accompanied kind
the sun-piercing and the victorious breath
free of pebbles and the like
free of cold, fire and water
meaning.hi: ठंड, आग और पानी से रहित

meaning.en: neither too high nor too low
meaning.hi: न बहुत ऊँचे, न बहुत नीचे

meaning.en: so that it touches, is felt
then release through the left channel
removing the heat that rises in the head
meaning.hi: सिर में उठी गर्मी को हरने वाला

meaning.en: clearing the phlegm of the throat
meaning.hi: गले के कफ को हरने वाला

meaning.en: increasing the fire of the body
meaning.hi: शरीर की अग्नि को बढ़ाने वाला

meaning.en: destroying faults settled in the tissues
meaning.hi: धातुओं में गए दोषों का नाश करने वाला

meaning.en: lumps, enlarged spleen and similar troubles
with neck and belly held in line
meaning.hi: गर्दन और पेट को सम रखे हुए

meaning.en: should push the breath out through the nose
meaning.hi: प्राण को नाक से बाहर निकाले

meaning.en: as far as the lotus of the heart
should fill in through the sun channel
sitting at the mouth of the Brahma channel

meaning.hi: जिनका मैल दूर हो गया है

meaning.en: and when apana has gone upward
meaning.hi: और अपान के ऊपर जाने पर

meaning.en: the inside of the Brahma channel
the root lock should be done
at the start of the out-breath
when seated in the thunderbolt posture
near the region of the ankles
the bulb from which the channels spread
in the heart and in the throat
at the end of the in-breath
in the form of a throat contraction
meaning.hi: गले के संकोच के रूप का

meaning.en: when the throat has been tightened
by the stretch of the back
one moving in the Brahma channel
and from the fault of uneven eating
meaning.hi: और बेढंगे भोजन के दोष से

meaning.en: then he gives up the practice
with a mind settled in clarity

meaning.hi: मन सुषुम्ना में लीन होता है

meaning.en: this is called the root lock
when stirred by the force of the breath
meaning.hi: प्राण के वेग से हिलने पर

meaning.en: from the grip of the sun
she goes to the moon's wheel
having the form of nature's eight parts
as they always were at birth
like gold in a crucible over fire
meaning.hi: आग पर घरिया में सोने की तरह

meaning.en: the body made of the elements
and attains the nature of the subtle body
meaning.hi: और सूक्ष्म वाहक-देह का भाव पाता है

meaning.en: of the nature of my Self
release from the bond of wife and worldly birth
meaning.hi: पत्नी और संसार के बन्धन से छुटकारा

meaning.en: of what has the form of time

meaning.hi: अपने ही स्वरूप के रूप में

meaning.en: like the rope and the snake
gripped by death, disease and age
meaning.hi: मृत्यु, रोग और बुढ़ापे से ग्रस्त

meaning.en: destroyer of age, death and disease
meaning.hi: बुढ़ापे, मृत्यु और रोग का नाशक

meaning.en: the Khechari knowledge is hard to find
its practice too is hard to find
even at the end of a hundred births
meaning.hi: सौ जन्मों के अन्त में भी

meaning.en: through the end of many births
from the lips of the guru
from the whole round of worldly life
as long as it is not found
the one who gives the practice
the knowledge as he teaches it
sharer in the attainment of Khechari
having become lord of the sky-movers
adorned with the circle of water
the ninth from the moon's portion
the letter in the form of the moon
know that likewise as the highest
and the fifth as its beginning
and obtainable through the guru's teaching
meaning.hi: और गुरु के उपदेश से प्राप्य
सब योगों में सिद्धि देने वाला

meaning.en: the illusion born of the body
and the end of wrinkles and grey hair
meaning.hi: और झुर्रियों और सफेद बालों का नाश

meaning.en: no success on the path of Khechari
and at the start of the joining
becomes a sharer in no attainment
meaning.hi: किसी भी सिद्धि का भागी नहीं होता

meaning.en: then should hold fast to the knowledge
in the way his own guru taught
meaning.hi: अपने गुरु के बताए प्रकार से

meaning.en: step by step in this way
bound by a cord of tissue
the seat of the goddess of speech
knowing the proper times and seasons
meaning.hi: समय और वेला के नियम का ज्ञाता

meaning.en: as far as the space between the brows
sideways as far as the ear openings
meaning.hi: बगल में कानों के छेद तक

meaning.en: with ease, as if in play
to the line of the hair
sideways as far as the temples
to the hollow of the throat
the opening of Brahma at the crown
reaches the crown of the head
meaning.hi: सिर के शिखर तक जाती है

meaning.en: downward to the cavity of the throat
breaker of the great diamond door
hard even for ascetics to find
for the sake of every attainment
for one who does it all at once
the tongue reaches the cavity of Brahma
hard to break even for the gods
once the door of Brahma is entered
for one who has mastered the Khechari mantra

meaning.hi: मन्थन के बिना सिद्ध होता है

meaning.en: in the opening of the nostril
with a thread soaked in milk
in a posture comfortable for oneself
should not keep travelling the path
at the end of twelve years
through its oneness with the Self
the coiled one above the royal teeth
and the first day of the fortnight
what meaning is given to these
meaning.hi: इनकी क्या संज्ञा बताई जाती है

meaning.en: from the first day of the fortnight
should take refuge in the stainless one

meaning.hi: और मन को शक्ति के बीच

meaning.en: the mind alone is the bindu
the cause of arising and continuance
and bondage is not in some middle place
meaning.hi: और बन्धन बीच में स्थित नहीं
चन्द्र और सूर्य के मध्य की

meaning.en: and the breath into the middle
in the seat of the bindu
at the openings of the nose
is said to be at the anus
and at the root of the throat
should enter the sphere of bliss
one who practises the breath thus
meaning.hi: जो इस प्रकार वायु का अभ्यास करे

meaning.en: and without the discipline of practice
when split open by the guru's words
by the strength of practice's habits
meaning.hi: अभ्यास के संस्कारों की शक्ति से

meaning.en: which rose in the order before
sets again by the reverse path
meaning.hi: उलटे क्रम से अस्त होती है

meaning.en: the person who always lives so
and the egg of the cosmos
the worlds from earth upward in order
through the melting of each one's limiting condition
meaning.hi: अपनी-अपनी उपाधि के लय से ही

meaning.en: heated by the fire of knowledge
like a lamp within a jar
meaning.hi: कलश के भीतर दीपक की तरह

meaning.en: through waking, dream and deep sleep
through the ripening of good deeds
dwelling in the small space of the heart
burns it up in an instant
meaning.hi: क्षण भर में जला देती है

meaning.en: the sheaths of mind and intellect
like a lamp within a jar
meaning.hi: घड़े में रखे दीपक की तरह

meaning.en: he is to be known as freed while alive
having done all there was to do
the state of being freed while alive
